column1: # Notes for scripts/gen-reference.sh (docs/REFERENCE.md and the README block are generated from the install scripts).
# name<TAB>group<TAB>since<TAB>description. group: empty = by the name prefix (col_ column index, table_ tables, else search), or search col table maint diag;
# - = internal, not listed. A description is only for the objects of the released scripts (a later one gets COMMENT ON in the SQL), and for a family
# of operator classes that a DO block creates (name with *: group and since are needed too).

column4: Full-text match of a text against a SiftQL query (words, phrases, prefixes, fuzzy terms, NOT, fields); a sift index answers it, with BM25 ranking through sift.score.
The function behind @@> with the default analyzer; the planner rebinds it to the index analyzer.
The function behind @@> for a column whose sift index uses another analyzer.
BM25 score of the row of a sift scan, in the same query (error anywhere else).
The largest BM25 score the query can give, for a scan (error anywhere else).
The text with the matched terms of a query wrapped in start_tag and stop_tag.
The tokens of a text under an index analyzer or given options: token, position and character offsets.
The parsed form of a SiftQL query under an index analyzer, as text.
Default operator class of the sift index for text: the @@> operator.
One row per segment of a sift index: documents, terms, bytes by section, dirty and dead documents.
Postings of a sift index by segment and document-frequency class: representation counts, codec bytes and bits per posting.
Space and directory state of a sift index: blocks, free list, segments, documents and whether maintenance runs.
Checks the structure of a sift index (and with heapallindexed, that every visible row is in it); raises on a problem.
Counts of the matches of a query per value of a keyword sift index, most frequent first.
Joins the fields of a document into the text a fields index is built on.
The query with the weights of its fields: each term searched in every field with its boost times the field weight.
Facet counts over a search: terms, range, histogram and date_histogram facets of any column type, several in one call.
The SQL statement that facet_counts runs, one scan per facet.
Turns the write buffer of a sift index into an immutable segment; returns the buffers promoted.
Merges the segments of a sift index into fewer; force merges even when no policy asks; returns the segments merged.
Version of the loaded library (the installed extension version is in pg_extension).
Default operator class of the sift_col index: it has no operators, the index is read by the column scans.
Operator classes per type (int2, int4, int8, float4, float8, date, timestamp, timestamptz, bool, numeric, text, bpchar, uuid) that let the planner scan a sift_col index; opt-in per column.
Space and directory state of a sift_col index: blocks, free list, segments, rows and the kernel level of the scans.
Pre-aggregates of every stored unit of a leaf of a sift_col index (debug and test hook).
Histogram of the groups of a dimension of a sift_col index per unit, with the count and sum of one measure (debug and test hook).
One row per segment of a sift_col index: rows, units, bytes, column format and the bytes of its pre-aggregates.
One row per leaf of a sift_col index: its chunks by encoding, their bytes and the bytes of its dictionaries.
Where the bytes of a sift_col index or a sift_table go, one row per kind; they add up to pg_relation_size.
Checks the structure of a sift_col index (and with heapallindexed, its rows against the heap); raises on a problem.
Turns the write buffer of a sift_col index into column segments; returns the segments written.
Merges the segments of a sift_col index into fewer; force merges even when no policy asks; returns the segments merged.
The rewrite of sift.col_auto_merge now, in this session: seals the write buffer and merges every segment when churn has scattered the index; false when nothing is due.
Why col_maintain would rewrite the index now (dirty units, fragmented units, write buffer rows), NULL when it is not due.
Server counters of the on-demand refresh of unit rollups: requested, refreshed, skipped, dropped, queued, refreshing.
The queued requests to refresh the rollups of a segment, with their state.
Refreshes the queued rollup requests of a sift_col index now, in this session; returns the segments rewritten.
The columns of col_rollup_counters as a view.
The rows of col_rollup_queue as a view.
One row per segment of a sift_table: write buffers, sealed buffers, column segments (rows, units, dead rows, format, unfrozen) and tombstones.
Space of a sift_table: file blocks, free list, reusable blocks and the virtual TID blocks left.
VACUUM's work on the column segments and the file of a sift_table without its indexes: clears dead rows, promotes buffers, rewrites mostly dead segments, returns the free end of the file.
Declares the JSON paths of a jsonb column of a sift_table, in the grammar of the paths option of sift_col; an empty spec removes it.
The declared JSON paths of the jsonb columns of sift_table tables (one row per table and column), dumped with the extension.
Placeholder member of the col_ops operator class, never called.
Helper of facet_sql: raises when a gap-filled histogram would return too many buckets.
Helper of facet_sql: the shape of one facet of a spec.
Helper of table_set_paths: checks that the table can hold the paths.
